certainty.decision: Distinct assessment targets over existing propositions/evidence; no family of certainty primitives, no fused generic confidence. A source/world separation, B generic target/method/basis contract, E probability calibration.

targets.scope: What occurred, not what was said
Current extraction of a specific passage; tentative minute is system uncertainty
Manual target/episode alignment, not source authenticity
Evidence snapshot, scope, alternatives and derived outcome

certainty.existing_core_underestimated: Claim.confidence already concerns its own proposition; separate Claim scopes prevent automatic inheritance. Belief confidence mean is descriptive, not fused.
certainty.remaining_constraint: Claim numeric confidence is mandatory; an uncalibrated source estimate is not unknown/reality probability. Qualitative assessment/reason/method remains sidecar, not fabricated numeric truth.

unknown.general_contract: Target+reason+basis+inspection/search scope; structural gaps reused; domain reason codes remain sidecar

distinctions.interpretation: Target value/role unresolved, no inferred replacement
No persisted record in explicit query/snapshot; not no-world-event
Explicit statement about observation/coverage; not general absence
Access/availability evidence about named target; not lost/nonexistent
Explicit evidence-bearing negative proposition, not a search failure

unknown.research_statuses: not_searched,searched_not_found,inaccessible,lost,archive_incomplete are domain search/survival metadata; only asserted with appropriate evidence. No new claim that these historical originals are lost.

temporal_role.decision: Existing instant/interval fields keep intended roles; generic role-labelled Time Assertion is B composition. Historical raw notation/conversion details D.
temporal_role.composition: Existing subject or reported candidate + relation Claim identifying time role + raw time/precision/clock/conversion status + Evidence
temporal_role.forbidden: No created/recorded timestamp backfill; no null applicability=unknown shortcut; no new per-stage timestamp field proliferation

propagation.decision: B sparse actor/message/stage/time evidence relations; no pipeline primitive
propagation.forbidden: No required stage list; no send→receipt→read→understood implication
propagation.branches: Recipient/payload/reference relations can branch; absent edge remains unknown. This review does not claim demonstrated loss/partial-delivery lifecycle.

provenance.general: B scoped evidence-bearing upstream endpoint relation; already-existing source provenance retained
provenance.limit: cites_for does not prove copied_from; no imported FRBR ontology or automatic authenticity verdict

evidence_dependency.decision: B scoped dependency/common-ancestor traversal; E independent corroboration verdict
evidence_dependency.limit: Distinct sources/IDs and explicit selected policy members are not independent roots. Existing resource ANY/ALL policy is a selected-source composition rule, not truth/independence/probability.

contradiction.decision: Reuse core SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS for genuine Evidence opposition and Belief divergence for one aligned proposition slot. B contrast dimension/alignment contract over reported propositions.
contradiction.case: Pallada/Pallida direct negation conditional on manual probable target alignment;53/54maybetransformationdifference;23:35explosionvs23:45gunfireisobservable difference.
contradiction.not_promoted: Universal closed contradiction taxonomy/automatic target matcher; later correction cannot be assumed from all differing values

reconstruction.definition: Derived assessment of explicitly available evidence at an evaluation boundary, retaining basis, scope, opposition and alternatives; not accepted ontic reality or a Narrative.
reconstruction.existing_general_analogue: BeliefAssessment and DecisionContextSnapshotV1 with evidence/claim/basis data, append-only Decision declarations
reconstruction.decision: B generic cross-scope assessment/evidence snapshot contract; E general revision/retraction/supersession lifecycle
reconstruction.round4_limit: Version1 has no explicit full evidence-cutoff instant. Source access dates and report dates are not a replacement; do not retroactively fill it.
